//: Railpack decides install/build/start BEFORE this file is applied, so buildCommand and startCommand are set on the service as RAILPACK_BUILD_CMD and RAILPACK_START_CMD.

build.//watchPatterns: Deliberately NOT set here. Config-as-code overrides the service setting, so keeping watch patterns in this file would mean a commit every time you toggle auto-deploy.

deploy.//preDeployCommand: Each platform's api service owns the migrations for ITS OWN database. The schema is shared code; the databases are not. The worker and cron services must never run this.
